Dr Alka Mundra has resigned as an Independent Director of Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IndianOil), effective September 18, 2026, citing a pecuniary relationship involving her son that could affect the independence criteria prescribed under SEBI regulations.
In her resignation letter, Mundra said her son, Madhav Mundra, has been operating an IndianOil retail outlet dealership, Swarn Ganga KSK, in Udaipur, Rajasthan, since 2020.
The relationship falls within the independence criteria under Regulation 16(1)(b)(v)(D) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations.

Mundra said that while her son operates the dealership independently and the arrangement would not affect her objectivity as a director, she decided to step down to maintain corporate governance standards and avoid questions over her independence.

She confirmed that there were no other material reasons behind her resignation. Mundra was not a member of any Board committees of IndianOil and does not hold directorships in any other listed entities.

IndianOil disclosed the resignation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. Mundra, whose Director Identification Number is 01581040, ceased to be an Independent Director with effect from September 18.
Indian Oil Corporation is listed on the National Stock Exchange under the symbol IOC and on the BSE under scrip code 530965.
